items.question: Let E and F be mutually exclusive events. Suppose P(E) = 0.4 and P(F) = 0.5. What is P(E|F)?
Let Q and R be independent events. Suppose P(Q) = 0.5 and P(Q AND R) = 0.2. What is P(R)?
Let U and V be mutually exclusive events. Suppose P(U) = 0.26 and P(V) = 0.37. What is P(U OR V)?
Let event B = a library patron checks out a book. Let event D = the patron checks out a DVD. Suppose P(B) = 0.40, P(D) = 0.30, and P(B AND D) = 0.20. What is P(D|B)?

You draw two cards from a fair, well-shuffled deck of 52 cards with replacement: you draw a card, put it back, shuffle, and draw a second card. Half of the cards are black. What is the probability that at least one of the two cards is black?
A bag contains 6 red marbles numbered 1 to 6 and 4 green marbles numbered 1 to 4. You pick one marble at random. What is the probability that it is green AND has an odd number?
